BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The vulnerable Visualforce page is accessible over the network and can be triggered via crafted requests.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: No special conditions are required beyond inline style usage in the page.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: Basic access to the application or page is required, but no elevated privileges.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: A user must view or load the affected page for the issue to have impact.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: The issue impacts the browser/UI context, affecting how content is rendered and trusted.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Limited exposure of UI-visible data may occur in certain injection scenarios.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: Inline styles can manipulate UI presentation and influence user perception.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: The issue does not impact system availability.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue can be demonstrated with simple payloads affecting UI rendering.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: Best practice is clearly defined: avoid inline styles and use CSS classes or static resources.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: Static analysis reliably identifies inline style usage.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_ATTACK_VECTOR
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: The application remains accessible over the network.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: No environmental factors increase attack complexity.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Basic access to the page is still required.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_USER_INTERACTION
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Users must interact with the affected page.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_SCOPE
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Impact remains in the browser/UI trust boundary.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_INTEGRITY
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: In the specific environment, UI manipulation can significantly mislead users, alter workflows, or influence business decisions.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: CONFIDENTIALITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Business data displayed on pages has moderate sensitivity.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: INTEGRITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Maintaining correct UI behavior and trust is important but not critical system integrity.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: AVAILABILITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Availability is not a key concern for this issue.
